task.title: Floor division operation
task.prompt: Support // in calculate() and the console menu using Python floor-division semantics. Reject floor division by zero with ValueError and keep the console running. Preserve +, -, *, /, finite-number input validation, and clean quit behavior.
task.description: Extend the console calculator with a floor-division operation.

data.summary: Added support for // (floor division) in the calculator, including input validation, error handling for division by zero, and console menu updates. Existing operations and behaviors are preserved.

data.summary: The proposed change adds support for the floor-division (//) operator to the calculator. It updates the calculate() function to handle //, including a check for division by zero, and modifies the user interface to present // as an option and validate it as a valid operator. Error messages and prompts are updated accordingly. The changes appear consistent with the requirements and preserve existing behaviors for other operators and input validation.
limitations: No automated tests are provided to verify the new // functionality.
The calculator only accepts finite float inputs; integer-specific behavior for // is not explicitly handled, but Python's // operator works for floats.
No localization or internationalization for error messages or prompts.
No handling for whitespace or case variations in operator input beyond .lower().
